c1-jas-0008: A visitor in fine clothes walked into the meeting place. Look closely at what James describes in James 2:2.
c2-jas-0002: Some people planned a trip to a city to make money. See what James says about tomorrow in James 4:14.
c2-jas-0003: Two visitors came in, and one was given a good place. Notice the words for the poor man in James 2:3 and James 2:4.
c2-jas-0004: The workers in the field were never given their pay. Find out who has noticed them in James 5:3 and James 5:4.
c3-jas-0001: Someone among the believers was feeling sick. See what James asks that person to do in James 5:13 and James 5:14.
c3-jas-0002: James has strong words for the wealthy, and a kind word for the poor. Compare James 5:1 with James 2:5.
c3-jas-0003: James invites believers to draw near to God. Then see what they share with each other in James 4:8 and James 5:16.
c3-jas-0004: James speaks plainly about knowing the right thing and not doing it. Think it through with James 4:17 and James 2:10.
c1-1pe-0002: Peter asks the elders to care for God's flock like shepherds. Look ahead with them to First Peter 5:4.
c2-1pe-0006: Peter wants believers to welcome each other into their homes. See how he says to do it in First Peter 4:9.
c2-1pe-0007: Some believers were suffering, and Peter wrote to them. Notice the reason he names in First Peter 4:15 and First Peter 4:16.
c2-1pe-0008: Peter wants elders to serve, not because they must. Find the right heart for it in First Peter 5:2 and First Peter 5:3.
c3-1pe-0003: Peter says doing good is God's will for His people. Find what doing good can quiet in First Peter 2:14 and First Peter 2:15.
c3-1pe-0004: Peter calls believers servants of God, each with something to give. Look at how to share it in First Peter 2:16 and First Peter 4:10.
c3-1pe-0005: Some people spoke against the believers' good conduct. See what he hopes for in First Peter 3:16 and First Peter 2:12.
c3-1pe-0006: Peter wants the elders to set an example for the flock. Then he asks a question in First Peter 5:3 and First Peter 3:13.
c1-1jn-0002: John writes warmly to the believers he loves. Notice what he tells them in First John 2:18.
c2-1jn-0006: John says the anointing from God stays with believers. See what that means for them in First John 2:27.
c2-1jn-0007: Some people walked away from the group of believers. Find what John says about them in First John 2:19 and First John 2:26.
c2-1jn-0008: Sometimes our hearts feel heavy and condemn us. Rest with John's words in First John 3:20 and First John 3:21.
c3-1jn-0003: John says real love lays down its life for others. Now picture a brother in need in First John 3:16 and First John 3:17.
c3-1jn-0004: John reminds us we have an Advocate with the Father. Then find why the Son came in First John 2:1 and First John 3:8.
c3-1jn-0005: John warns about the liar who denies the Father and the Son. Then he comforts God's family in First John 2:22 and First John 4:4.
c3-1jn-0006: John says God's Spirit lives in those who belong to Him. See what knowing God looks like in First John 3:24 and First John 4:6.
c1-eph-0007: Paul asks believers not to sadden the Holy Spirit. Find the day they were sealed for in Ephesians 4:30.
c2-eph-0001: Paul speaks to the Ephesians as God's dear family. See what he asks them to be in Ephesians 5:1.
c2-eph-0002: Lying must be put away, and truth spoken to a neighbor. Find his reason in Ephesians 4:25 and Ephesians 4:26.
c2-eph-0003: Paul warns that some people try to fool others. Notice his warning in Ephesians 5:6 and Ephesians 5:7.
c3-eph-0002: Paul pictures believers sharing psalms and hymns with each other. See what happens in their hearts in Ephesians 5:19 and Ephesians 5:20.
c3-eph-0003: Christ loved the church and gave Himself for her. Think about His offering in Ephesians 5:25 and Ephesians 5:2.
c3-eph-0004: Paul talks about putting on the new man, made in holiness. Look at how Christ presents His church in Ephesians 4:24 and Ephesians 5:27.
c3-eph-0005: Paul gives fathers a gentle word about their homes. Then see what must be put away in Ephesians 6:4 and Ephesians 4:31.
c1-jud-0001: Jude begins by calling himself a servant of Jesus Christ. See who else he names in Jude 1:1.
c2-jud-0001: Jude remembers Enoch, a man who spoke for God long ago. See how Jude places him in Jude 1:14.
c2-jud-0002: Jude remembers Balaam and Korah, men who went the wrong way. Look at the paths Jude describes in Jude 1:11 and Jude 1:16.
c2-jud-0003: Jude says mockers would come in the last time. Notice how he describes them in Jude 1:18 and Jude 1:19.
c3-jud-0001: Jude asks the beloved to remember a warning about mockers. Find who spoke of it first in Jude 1:17 and Jude 1:18.
c3-jud-0002: Jude asks believers to keep themselves while they wait for mercy. See how God can present them in Jude 1:21 and Jude 1:24.
c3-jud-0003: Jude urges believers to stand up for what they were given. Notice why the Lord comes in Jude 1:3 and Jude 1:15.
c3-jud-0004: Jude prays that mercy, peace, and love be multiplied. Then find what the beloved build on in Jude 1:2 and Jude 1:20.
